data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for reading native device orientation from UI or sensors.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to read the native device orientation on Android and iOS. It differentiates between landscape left and landscape right, and can optionally read orientation directly from device sensors.
use_when: You need to differentiate between landscape left and landscape right.
You need to read orientation directly from device sensors instead of just window size.
You want built-in widgets to handle orientation layouts automatically.
avoid_when: Standard Flutter orientation checks based on screen dimensions are sufficient for your app.
strengths: Differentiates landscape left from landscape right.
Supports both UI orientation and direct sensor readings.
Provides convenient built-in reader and oriented widgets.
weaknesses: Sensor-based orientation has been tested less thoroughly.
Requires platform-specific configuration adjustments for Swift Package Manager on iOS.
data.setup_notes: May require cleaning build files or adjusting iOS folder settings when using Swift Package Manager.
